passed: The Sales frame shows the plan card (no photo) with the invoice steps, estimate, Draft badge and review controls
Hover reveals the grip and remove button; focus ring shows on keyboard focus
Rename: Enter or double-click opens a field, Enter saves, Esc cancels, blur saves, blank is ignored
Keyboard: arrows move focus, Alt+arrows move the step (focus follows, announced), Delete collapses it, Add step keeps the field ready
Remove button collapses the row and closes the gap; the last step can be removed too, then the plan cannot run
Dragging by the grip: the step follows the pointer, the others slide aside, and everything settles in the new order
Reorder glides (FLIP): a keyboard move animates every affected step instead of jumping
Cancel restores the plan as first given
Run: steps go pending -> active (live timer) -> done (took Ns), the rail fills, editing folds away, the footer shows Running · N of 5 with the elapsed time
The invoice engine: Draft until it is sent; the send fails once ("Stopped · step 3 failed"), the clock stops; Retry from here sends it (Unpaid), then payment is recorded (Paid), "Done in Ns"
Edited plans run as edited: removed steps are skipped, added steps run, the badge follows the effects
